intro: Every cross below was bred by hand in a tent. The other {outside} plants on the star chart are the outside genetics they came from — mapped so you can see where each one leads back to.
footnote: Not a company. Seeds are never sold. Small batch, organic, one-time chucks. 100 to 2,000 seeds of each line in the vault.
rosterLede: The complete list. One pollen donor per run, chosen out of a pack and put over every mother in the tent. Tap any name for the full readout.
chartHint: Drag to pan · pinch or scroll to zoom · tap a plant to light up its family. Time runs left to right.
